summary.text: Tim Dunn is a Republican member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 25; he assumed office on January 13, 2025, and his predecessor was Sine Kerr.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2018 to 2025.
He was born and lives in Yuma, Arizona, and earned a B.S. in agriculture from the University of Arizona.
His career experience includes owning Tim Dunn Farms, Dunn Grain Co. Inc., and four Sport Clips Haircuts franchise stores.
He advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
